app.name: Gom Jabbar
diary.emptyHint: What you log will show up here.
trends.soon: Coming soon: body heatmap, trends, report.
settings.install: Add to your Home screen to use it offline and keep your data safe.
settings.dataNote: Your data lives only on this phone.
region.head: head
help.tap: Tap the areas that hurt on the two figures. With “Both sides” on, tapping one leg also selects the other.
help.level: Drag the slider for intensity: the number sits in the knob.
help.areas: Different levels in different places? Tap “+ Another area”, then tap the other areas and adjust the slider. The slider always acts on the highlighted area.
help.ongoing: “Ongoing” marks an episode that is still going: it stays at the top until you end it.
help.time: Logging something from earlier? Pick when with the time buttons.
help.undo: Every save, edit or delete can be undone right away from the message at the bottom.
help.edit: In the Diary, tap an entry to edit or delete it.
